channel.title: Pink iPod
channel.description: Independent music blog by Juliette Cabanac: long interviews with emerging artists, listening diaries and playlists.

item.title: Maya Donovan is a Crooner
item.dc:creator: Juliette Cabanac
item.description:
Maya Donovan, the Brooklyn folk singer songwriter, talks about Ceremony, crooning and intimacy in a long interview with Pink iPod.

Read on Pink iPod

item.title: If Phoebe Waller Bridge made music she would have had a show at the Pop-Up on September 10th and her name would be Kate Stephenson
item.dc:creator: Juliette Cabanac
item.description:
Nashville singer songwriter Kate Stephenson talks humour and songwriting before her first Paris show at the Pop Up du Label, with Selkee and Fairhazel.

Read on Pink iPod

item.title: Listen to Beastie before he rules the world
item.dc:creator: Juliette Cabanac
item.description:
Pink iPod meets BEASTIE, the Mitcham, South London artist behind Sofia and Hellscraper, for a long conversation in Paris about his craft and origins.

Read on Pink iPod

item.title: Bothsxdes is conflicted about London, social media and being vulnerable
item.dc:creator: Juliette Cabanac
item.description:
bothsxdes, the French artist split between Paris and London, talks about his EP Wholehearted, vulnerability, social media and his first headline show.

Read on Pink iPod

item.title: A.G Sully, my doppelgänger from Alabama
item.dc:creator: Juliette Cabanac
item.description:
A.G Sully, the Alabama raised songwriter now living in Montréal, on Space to Think, Premonition of Rain and her blend of pop, soul and R&B.

Read on Pink iPod

item.title: Don’t be scared, long distance works !!
item.dc:creator: Juliette Cabanac
item.description:
Francis of Champion Trees, the South African band spread between London, Paris and South Africa, talks lyrics, distance and writing with Pink iPod.

Read on Pink iPod

item.title: Marcus Frame : Found
item.dc:creator: Juliette Cabanac
item.description:
Pink iPod finally interviews Marcus Frame, the Scottish singer and rapper, about DJing, drum and bass, a secret alias and the album he is making.

Read on Pink iPod

item.title: WANTED : Who is Marcus Frame ?
item.dc:creator: Juliette Cabanac
item.description:
Who is Marcus Frame? Pink iPod traces the Scottish singer, rapper and composer behind More Bass, somewhere between jazz, spoken rap and drum and bass.

Read on Pink iPod

item.title: The Army, The Navy : Fairies Make Music Too !
item.dc:creator: Juliette Cabanac
item.description:
A listening diary on The Army, The Navy, the duo behind Fruit For Flies: close harmonies, finger style guitar, jazzy drums and a world of insects.

Read on Pink iPod
